name: Ridenza – Chauffeur & Limo Booking Forms
author: death404

sections.description:
Ridenza turns your WordPress site into a booking desk for a limousine or chauffeur business. Customers send a ride request in a clean, mobile-friendly form; you get an email, see it in a simple pipeline, and confirm it. No online payment is taken: you stay in control of every booking.

It is built for owners, not developers. Activate it and you get a booking page, sample vehicles and a setup checklist. Everything else is point and click.

Booking forms

  • Multi-step form: your details → trip → vehicle → confirm, with a live ride summary beside it.
  • Quick forms for hero sections and sidebars, as a horizontal “pill” bar or a vertical card, in three sizes (Simple, Max, Full).
  • Point-to-point, by the hour and airport transfers. Hourly asks for hours; airport transfers offer your own airport list and a flight number field.
  • Return trips and extra stops, passengers and bags, and a preferred payment method (a preference only — nothing is charged).
  • Availability rules: minimum notice, how far ahead, opening hours, time steps, closed weekdays, blocked dates and ranges, a daily limit and fleet size. The calendar greys out what is not bookable and the server checks everything again.

Drag-and-drop form builder

  • Drag fields onto a 12-column grid, or click to add them. Reorder by dragging.
  • Resize a field by dragging its edge, with separate widths for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • Switch the canvas between desktop, tablet and mobile, or open a live preview inside your own theme.
  • Booking fields, layout pieces (step break, heading with H2/H3/H4, rich text, divider) and your own questions (text, number, dropdown, choice, checkbox). Answers are saved with the booking.
  • Add a step break to turn any form into a multi-step form.
  • Card, plain or pill-bar styles, undo/redo and templates to start from: Simple, Max, Full, Multi-step, Airport transfer, Events & hourly.
  • Forms adapt to the space they sit in, so one form works in a full-width hero, a column or a sidebar.

Fleet and vehicle pages

  • Each vehicle is a normal WordPress post with its own SEO-friendly page, for example /fleet/business-class/. It works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math and the WordPress sitemap.
  • Choose the URL (fleet, cars, limousines…) and turn on a fleet listing page with a rich text intro, a rich text section for longer copy and a meta description.
  • Vehicle pages show a large photo, specs, highlights, your description, a one-step booking form with the vehicle already chosen, a call-to-action banner and other vehicles. Optional schema.org data is added for search engines.
  • Assign each vehicle to the services it is offered for. Customers only see matching vehicles that fit their group and are free that day.
  • Each vehicle can be live or hidden, with or without its own page.

Built to convert

  • Incomplete leads: contact details are saved after the first step, so you can call people who drop off (can be switched off).
  • Entries survive a page reload, errors show inline as people type, and mobile keyboards match each field.
  • Trust points, a reassurance line under the button and one-tap “Prefer to talk?” phone and WhatsApp links.
  • A clear success screen with a reference number, next steps and an “Add to calendar” file, or a redirect to your own thank-you page.

Manage requests

  • Pipeline: Incomplete → New → Contacted → Confirmed → Completed, plus Cancelled and Lost.
  • One-tap call, WhatsApp and email from each booking, internal notes and a timeline of every change and email.
  • Each request records its form, page, referrer, UTM campaign tags and device, so you can see which ads bring bookings.
  • Dashboard with new requests, incomplete leads, form conversion rate, average response time and top sources.
  • CSV export, an activity log, and one-click demo data you can remove again.

Emails

Notifications go through WordPress (wp_mail), so any SMTP plugin works. You get an email for every new request; customers get a “request received” email and, optionally, an email when you confirm or cancel. All templates are editable with placeholders, and every send or failure is logged.

Works with your site

  • Shortcodes, blocks (search “Ridenza” in the editor) and classic widgets.
  • Neutral styling that follows your theme’s fonts, with one accent colour and a choice of corner style.
  • Works on cached pages. Spam protection with a honeypot, a time check and a per-visitor rate limit — no CAPTCHA needed in most cases.
  • Translation-ready.

Shortcodes

  • [ridenza] – multi-step booking form
  • [ridenza_quick preset="simple|max|full" layout="pill|vertical"] – quick forms
  • [ridenza_form id="12"] – a form you built in Ridenza → Forms
  • [ridenza_vehicle id="45"] – the booking form for one vehicle
  • [ridenza_fleet columns="3" service=""] – vehicle grid

Privacy

Booking requests are stored in your own WordPress database: the details the customer enters, plus the page they came from, referrer, campaign tags, device, IP address and browser for spam protection and reporting. If “Save incomplete leads” is on, contact details from the first step of a multi-step form are stored before the form is sent; mention this in your privacy policy, or switch it off under Ridenza → Settings → Conversion. The plugin can delete all its data when it is removed (Settings → Advanced).

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. Emails are sent by your own site through wp_mail().

For developers

  • Template overrides: copy any file from templates/ to yourtheme/ridenza/. Vehicle pages can also be taken over with single-chdk_vehicle.php and archive-chdk_vehicle.php in your theme.
  • Filters: chdk_booking_data, chdk_validation_errors, chdk_booking_detail_rows, chdk_email_headers, chdk_email_html, chdk_capability, chdk_frontend_config, chdk_vehicle_schema.
  • Actions: chdk_booking_created, chdk_partial_lead, chdk_booking_status_changed.
  • JavaScript: chdk:submitted fires after a successful request; dispatch chdk:init to start forms added to the page later (for example in popups).
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Ridenza” and click Install Now, then Activate. (Or upload the zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.)
  2. A Book a Ride page and starter vehicles are created for you. Open Ridenza → Dashboard and follow the short checklist.
  3. Add your vehicles under Ridenza → Fleet: photo, seats, bags and the services each one is offered for.
  4. Set where new requests are emailed under Ridenza → Settings → Emails, and send yourself a test email.
  5. Put a form anywhere with a block, a widget or one of the shortcodes above. Build your own under Ridenza → Forms.

Want to look around first? Ridenza → Settings → Advanced → Import demo data adds sample bookings, vehicles and a page showing every form. Remove it again with one click.
sections.faq:
Does it take payments?

No. Ridenza collects booking requests that you confirm yourself. Customers can choose a preferred payment method (for example cash, card on board or invoice) so you know what they expect, but nothing is charged online.

Can it calculate prices?

Not in this version. You confirm the price when you reply to the request. You can add your own questions to any form with the form builder if you need more details to quote.

Does it send SMS?

No. Notifications are sent by email through WordPress. Each booking has one-tap call and WhatsApp buttons so you can reach customers quickly from your phone.

Emails are not arriving. What can I do?

Go to Ridenza → Settings → Emails and send a test email, then check Ridenza → Logs for errors. Many hosts do not deliver mail sent by PHP reliably; installing any SMTP plugin usually fixes this, as all emails go through wp_mail().

Will it match my theme?

The forms use neutral colours and inherit your theme’s fonts. Pick one accent colour and a corner style under Settings → General. Templates can be overridden by copying them to yourtheme/ridenza/.

Does it work with Elementor and other page builders?

Yes. Use the shortcodes in any shortcode or text widget. If a form ever shows unstyled inside a builder or popup, switch on Settings → Advanced → Load form styles on every page.

Can I use it only as a fleet listing with vehicle pages?

Yes. Under Settings → Pages you can turn off the booking page, keep vehicle pages and the fleet listing, and every vehicle page includes its own booking form.

Can I change the vehicle page address from /fleet/ to /cars/?

Yes, under Settings → Pages → URL slug. Links update automatically; you do not need to re-save permalinks.

Is it GDPR friendly?

All data stays in your WordPress database. You can add a consent checkbox, switch off incomplete-lead capture, export requests to CSV, delete them, and have all plugin data removed on uninstall. See the Privacy section above.

Does it work on cached pages?

Yes. Forms do not rely on nonces that expire in cached HTML; spam is blocked with a honeypot, a minimum fill time and a per-visitor rate limit.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. All text uses the ridenza text domain and can be translated at translate.wordpress.org or with a translation plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fix: on themes and page builders that add line breaks to shortcode output, field icons sat too high and the selected payment option, consent checkbox, service type and return-trip switch did not show as selected.
  • The selected service type is clearly outlined.
  • Choosing a vehicle is optional; without one the request goes in as “Any vehicle”.
  • Choosing a vehicle moves to the next step on every screen size, and Continue stays in view on the vehicle step.

1.0.1

  • Mobile: service type is a row of icon pills instead of a stacked list.
  • Mobile: choosing a vehicle moves to the next step automatically.
  • Mobile: tighter payment options and a larger, easier consent checkbox.
  • Field icons stay aligned when an error message or the “Other airport” box appears.
  • The selected payment option shows a solid dot.
  • Fix: the consent checkbox sat above its text instead of beside it.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
